text: v1.0.0 contracts published: openapi.yaml (38 paths, /api/v1, x-roles/x-module), domain/*.schema.json (20 incl. TenantConfig + Condition language), events/*.schema.json (envelope + 10 claim.* + tenant.config.updated), modules.md (ctx.modules service fns, events, tables); registry in org/contracts/registry.json (34 entries)
Routing lives in rules module (publishes claim.routed); regulatory timers live in claims; claims is sole writer of Claim.status; coverage/evidence results in claim.checks not sub-states
Events carry no PII (ids/codes/scores only); webhooks signed HMAC-SHA256; outbox written in same txn as state change, at-least-once, consumers idempotent on evt.id
Contracts v1.0.0 locked: architecture/contracts/. Modules export service(ctx) (init(ctx) also accepted)

SECURITY DEFECT in src/core/store.mjs forTenant rewrite (verified with a probe): SELECT FROM "claims" / `claims` / main.claims are NOT tenant-filtered (cross-tenant read); update(table,id,{tenant_id}) and run('UPDATE t SET tenant_id=?') move rows across tenants; tctx.db exposes raw/system/forTenant. Ask: platform rejects quoted/qualified identifiers on tenant tables, strips tenant_id from update patches/SET, drops raw from tctx.db. Tracked as R1/R3 in threat-model.md

Contract vs core drift (security-relevant): openapi roles tenant_admin/auditor vs core ROLES carrier_admin/platform_admin/agent; JWT claim tid vs core tenantId; claimIds (claimant scoping) not carried by core tokens; token request userId/ttlMinutes vs core sub/ttlSeconds; envelope tenantId+source pattern vs bus tenantid,/fnol-platform; overview says ciphertext carries key version and tenant_keys table exists but crypto.mjs is HKDF from one master key (enc:v1 is format version, no key id). Proposed smallest additions: role alias map tenant_admin->carrier_admin + auditor role in core; claimIds claim; enc:v2:<keyId> format. Timer kind enum lacks 'pay' (compliance mapping documents pay deadlines as core-system owned; optional 'pay' kind proposed for v1.1)

Roles drift: openapi x-roles use 'auditor' and 'tenant_admin' which src/core/auth.mjs ROLES lacks (has carrier_admin, agent); GET /audit registered roles [supervisor,carrier_admin,platform_admin] vs documented [auditor,tenant_admin,supervisor]; /health documented but core registers /healthz; /auth/me not registered; /auth/token body documented as userId/displayName but core takes sub/name. Security suite tracks these as todo tests.

Coverage 1.1.0 (modules.md): adds seedPolicies(policies[]) -> {inserted} and getSnapshotById; mock table renamed mock_policies -> coverage_policies; CoverageVerification gains additive status/deductible/limits/applicableCoverages (schema has additionalProperties:false, please add them to CoverageVerification.schema.json); ticket status codes in_force|lapsed|excluded map onto outcome enum. REQUEST: bump module.contracts in org/contracts/registry.json to 1.1.0 (outside integrations paths).

POST /auth/token: openapi says userId/displayName and 201 {token,expiresAt,principal}; core reads sub/name and returns 200 {token,tokenType,claims}. devLogin sends both field sets; please align spec or core.

Domain PII marking gaps: common.Location.description (free text) and Location.geo (GeoPoint) are not x-pii but identify a person; propose marking both x-pii (additive). Logger REDACT misses dateOfBirth, injuryDescription, description, body, ip, 'licence' spelling (verified via redact()); see architecture/data-protection.md s2/s6

config: core auth ROLES lacks tenant_admin and auditor named in openapi x-roles; config routes accept carrier_admin as tenant_admin equivalent. Also tenant_configs table is owned by core (ctx.tenants), so config has no own migration. TenantConfig.timers[].state is a UsState, so 'timers reference known states' is checked against LOB states plus stopOn.toStatus against lifecycle states.

CSR portal: (1) openapi has no policy search route; using GET /policies/{policyNumber}/snapshot?asOf (exact lookup, 0-1 results). Request optional GET /policies?q= for real search. (2) IntakeStep gives only progress.requiredRemaining; request optional additive IntakeStep.missing[] ({questionId,text}); CSR derives from seen questions until then. (3) Channel enum has csr_phone, not 'csr'; CSR uses csr_phone. (4) shared api.post() ignores headers so Idempotency-Key needs a wrapper client (platform/experience kit).

integrations: openapi x-roles use tenant_admin/auditor but ROLES in core auth has carrier_admin and no tenant_admin/auditor; webhook routes accept [tenant_admin, carrier_admin] so both work. Suggest aligning role names in openapi.yaml or core ROLES.

integrations: core outbox table has no sequence column (modules.md says it does). GET /integrations/outbox derives sequence as 1-based position via ctx.bus.outbox and prefers a core 'sequence' field if added. Request: platform adds outbox.sequence (per-tenant monotonic) and a limit/after option on bus.outbox.

rules 1.0 clarifications: (1) validateRules and evaluateCondition are synchronous (config needs sync); evaluate/route/buildFacts/getRoutingDecision async. (2) Routing precedence: first route_queue in ascending priority wins (seeded priority-90 default rules would otherwise override injury/SIU); approved fast track beats default queues; deny_fast_track beats fast_track; fast track also requires coverage.outcome=covered and tenant fastTrack limits. (3) additive route() opts sourceEventId/auto and service fn onClaimTriaged(evt); routing_decisions gains seq, source_event_id, actions, actions_done. (4) answers fact comes from intake.getSession(claim.intakeSessionId).answers when available, else claim.answers. Please update modules.md domain-model.md section 4 'last route_queue wins'.

AdjusterView schema has no header/flags/nextBestActions keys (additionalProperties:false). Implemented as claim (header) with derived flags merged into claim.flags, and nextActions (items also carry priority, source). ai.run returns tier as AiProvenance integer (0 local,1 cheap,2 strong) plus tierName; tenant comes from opts.tenantId (ctx.ai is root-bound) or ai.forTenant(id). Task 'next_question' (intake/openapi) is not one of the 8 tasks and throws validation_error. adjuster_inbox gains additive columns claim_number, lob, complexity, next_timer, reported_at.

claims: additive event claim.updated {claimId, change, version, ...ids} published for mutations with no dedicated event (flag, task, external ref, reserve, routing/checks/triage updates from events, timer started/met/cancelled). Also service additions applyEvent/applyTimerEvent/sweepTimers(now). Seeded onBreach add_task type timer_breach_followup and stopOn taskType acknowledge_claimant are outside the Task.type enum: stored as 'other' with the requested type kept for timer matching.

evidence: (1) Document.extraction gains optional boolean needsReview (status 'partial' + needsReview=true for unreadable PDFs / low-confidence photos). (2) openapi x-roles lists 'auditor' but core auth ROLES has no auditor, so tokens cannot carry it. (3) Upload limit is 10 MB (413), allowed types jpeg/png/webp/heic/gif/pdf/text-plain (415).

intake additive: POST /intake/sessions/{id}/narrative {text}->IntakeStep; IntakeStep gains prompt, locale, optional[] (unanswered optional questions; question stays null when only optional remain), blocked[]; answer item accepts provenance 'ai_extraction' to confirm a pending suggestion; 422 answer response is {error,...IntakeStep}; roles claimant/csr/agent/integration/carrier_admin; tenant sample questions use mapsTo 'loss.*' (accepted as alias of lossEvent.*)

triage: TriageResult.subrogation (additionalProperties:false) lacks 'confidence'; ticket S1-AI-04 needs {flag,reasons,confidence}. Implemented as additive subrogation.confidence (0-1); please add to TriageResult.schema.json. Also: severityBand names follow the schema (minor/moderate/major/severe); AI fraud weights in points are normalized to 0-1; triage_results gains additive columns input_hash, source_event_id; prior-claims count is read from bundle.priorClaimsCount/priorClaims[]/accepted fact priorClaims (no contract source yet); triage service adds onEvent(kind, evt).

tenant_admin is used in openapi x-roles (webhooks) and integrations routes but is not in src/core/auth.mjs ROLES, so no token can be minted for it; tests skip those routes. Also GET /claims/{id}/documents returns 200 {items:[]} for unknown claim (no leak; evidence team may prefer 404).
Roles: core now issues tenant_admin and auditor per openapi; POST /auth/token returns 201 {token, expiresAt, principal} and accepts userId/displayName; GET /audit roles per contract

Coverage 1.2.0 additive: GET /api/v1/policies?q= (roles csr,agent,adjuster,supervisor) -> {items: PolicySummary[], matchedOn}; PolicySummary = {policyNumber,lob,status,period,riskState,insuredName,contact:{phone:'***-***-0101',postalCode:'606**'},description,vehicleCount,propertyCount}; service.searchByQuery(q), searchPolicies accepts policyNumberPrefix; commercial_auto rules (fleet units w/ addedDate/removedDate, HNOA via vehicle role/ownership hired|non_owned, cargo needs CARGO endorsement+coverage via facts.cargoInvolved / lossEvent.cargoInvolved). Please add PolicySummary to openapi.yaml and /policies path; no cargo LossCause exists in common schema so cargo is a flag

kpi 1.0: GET /api/v1/kpis?from&to is not in openapi.yaml. Response {period:{from,to}, metrics:[{id,label,valueDriver,value|null,unit(ratio|minutes),numerator|null,denominator|null,definition,note?}], truncated?}; roles supervisor,tenant_admin,carrier_admin,auditor; 400 bad_request on invalid dates/from>to; default last 30 days. No claim.acknowledged event exists: ack time = that event if a tenant emits it, else acknowledge timer metAt. Please add path + kpi to modules.md

S2-AI-01: guardrails are built but not wired. To route every provider call through them, src/ai/index.mjs (AI team) should pass providers through guardProviders(...) from src/ai/guardrails.mjs, and cascade getProvider should wrap lazily loaded providers with guard(p, undefined, {log, tenantId}). Guarded run() never throws; on invalid output or oversize it returns {refusal:true,error}, which the cascade already treats as a skip. Cloud is any provider whose locality/kind is not 'local' (falls back to name !== 'local'); providers need no change.

evidence/adjuster hardening: (1) AdjusterView (additionalProperties:false) gains additive top-level 'timestamps' {reportedAt, acknowledgedAt, assignedAt}; Claude/AdjusterView schemas are closed so please add it. ackAt = claim.acknowledged event else acknowledge timer metAt; assignedAt = routing.decidedAt when assigned/fast_tracked. (2) summary gains citedFacts [{name,value}] and text ends with a 'Facts used:' line (schema summary is open). (3) TenantConfig is closed: evidence upload cap read from optional config.evidence.maxUploadBytes (default 10 MB); please add to TenantConfig.schema.json. (4) Evidence now sniffs magic bytes; declared/actual mismatch is 415 unsupported_media_type.
Add optional HOST env (default 127.0.0.1) read by src/server.mjs main entry; Dockerfile currently binds 0.0.0.0 via inline createApp({host}) as workaround

rules (additive): a tenant with no queues gets implicit queues 'general' (platform default, or config.defaultQueue) and fastTrack.queue; a route_queue with no queue falls back to the tenant default queue; a tenant with no routing-stage rules gets PLATFORM-STP-DEFAULT (fast track when triage.fastTrackEligible, still behind the fast-track guard). triage (additive): bands now read TenantConfig.severityBands (top level, per schema; previously read triage.severityBands, which is not in the schema); TriageResult.suggestedReserve set from the accepted evidence estimateTotal; factors gain name 'calibration' (platform points for total loss/not recovered, insured vehicle not drivable or towed, uninhabitable dwelling, commercial line). Doc gap: domain-model fact example vehicles[*].drivable fails the TenantConfig fact pattern, which needs vehicles.[*].drivable; please align one of them.

Re contract-change 20:45:39.667Z (S2-ARC-01, v1.2.0): ACCEPT (MODIFY name): modules.md core documents a per-tenant strictly increasing outbox column named seq (S2-PLT-01: MAX+1 in the publish txn, backfilled in created_at,rowid order, unique (tenant_id, seq), never reused). Re contract-change 20:53:13.539Z (S2-ARC-01, v1.2.0): ACCEPT: AdjusterView keeps claim as header; derived flags documented as merged into claim.flags (optional top-level flags added); nextActions items gain priority (high|medium|low or number) and source (rule|ai). Re contract-change 21:19:11.341Z (S2-ARC-01, v1.2.0): ACCEPT: modules.md rules documents implicit queues, route_queue-without-queue fallback and PLATFORM-STP-DEFAULT (behind the fast-track guard); triage documents top-level severityBands, suggestedReserve from estimateTotal and calibration factors; ADR-003 cut-offs in domain-model section 3. Contracts v1.2.0 published (additive): openapi 1.2.0 (roles = registered routes, /healthz, auth/token 201, intake narrative + IntakeStep fields, GET /policies?q=, GET /kpis), schemas PolicySummary + Kpi + claim.updated, x-pii on Location.description/geo, modules.md 1.2.0 (routing precedence, ADR-003 bands, outbox seq, crypto as built), registry 38 entries. 25 contract-change requests answered.

S2-SEC-01: runtime deviates from openapi: intake routes also admit role agent (SEC2-001); undocumented GET/POST /integrations/fake-core/claims and POST /intake/sessions/{id}/narrative exist (SEC2-003); GET /claims/{id}/coverage also admits integration. Please decide: add to contract with roles, or remove from code.

S3-WFL-01: intake roles now claimant, csr, agent, integration (carrier_admin/tenant_admin removed; update modules.md intake roles + openapi x-roles). Ownership rule: claimant own sessions only; agent own sessions or sessions on policies it produces (injectable coverage lookup, fail closed, 404 otherwise); csr/integration tenant-wide. Request: PolicySnapshot has no producer/agent field, so default producer check is closed unless setCoverageLookup is injected; please add optional producer {agentId} to PolicySnapshot. Question validation.pattern: unsafe regexes are skipped at evaluation (config validator should also reject).
claim.status.changed: 'reason' (free text) replaced by 'reasonCode' (token ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,39}$); status request gains optional reasonCode; claims service adds listStatusHistory().

S3-QE-01: tenants/*.json set integrations.claimsPort.settings.fieldMapProfile ('mapping-a' aurelia, 'mapping-b' kestrel) but src/modules/integrations/adapters/index.mjs profileOf() reads settings.profile ('A'|'B', default A). Result: kestrel-point pushes profile A (nested ACORD JSON) instead of B (flat). GET /integrations/adapters shows profile A for both. Please decide the canonical key (settings.profile vs fieldMapProfile=mapping-a|b) and align tenants or adapter; tests/e2e/tenant-differences.test.mjs asserts the effective profile differs and reports t.todo until fixed.

S3-INT-02: (1) openapi should document GET/POST /integrations/fake-core/claims (GET roles tenant_admin, carrier_admin, supervisor, PII redacted for non-PII roles; POST roles integration, tenant_admin, carrier_admin, 256 KiB cap -> 413). (2) TenantConfig notifications.webhooks.allowedHosts is now enforced; empty/missing denies unless devMode; entries exact host or *.suffix.
POST /intake/sessions/{id}/submit returns only {id, claimNumber, status}; openapi says it returns the full Claim schema (lob, channel, tenantId missing). E2E works around by GET /claims/{id}.

Gaps found while scripting the demo: (1) intake maps no insured vehicle or policy number on claimant/CSR paths so coverage stays needs_review and glass never fast tracks from the UI; (2) CSR text field cannot answer 'party' questions (Aurelia other_party_info), blocking PR-SUBRO-AUTO; (3) POST /integrations/webhooks accepts hosts outside notifications.webhooks.allowedHosts; (4) POST /claims drops an 'answers' property silently. No contract change made; requesting owners' triage.

S4-QE-01: demo beat 5 needs a non-null acknowledgment time (KPI median_minutes_to_acknowledgment) but no tenant rule creates the acknowledge_claimant task that stops the acknowledge timer (MI-ACK etc.), and nothing emits claim.acknowledged, so the metric is always null after the demo flow (denominator 3, numerator 0). Please decide: add a rule/task action or an acknowledge endpoint/status transition that meets the timer and emits claim.acknowledged. Test reports t.todo until fixed. (tests/e2e/demo-script.test.mjs)

Party.schema.json has no atFault field; CSR and claimant party sub-forms send atFault:true (boolean) on the party object, passed through by intake mapping. Please add Party.atFault (boolean) so subrogation can read it.

Insured vehicle pick: tenant question sets have no vehicle-type question, so POST /answers for questionId 'insured_vehicle' (value {policyVehicleId,vin,year,make,model}) is rejected as unknown and the claim carries no vehicles[role=insured]. Request: add an unconditional optional 'insured_vehicle' question (type vehicle) to personal_auto sets in tenants/*.json. UIs already send it and target any vehicle-type question.

Claimant role cannot read GET /policies/{n}/snapshot (403/redacted) or GET /policies?q=, so the claimant vehicle picker stays hidden with real tokens. Request: allow claimant to read vehicles (unitId,vin,year,make,model only) for the policy on their own intake session. UI tests stub the snapshot.

S4-EXP-01 rework: still needed server-side (UIs now surface the rejection and tests prove the claim stores vehicles[role=insured] once the tenant question exists): (1) add optional unconditional 'insured_vehicle' (type vehicle) question to personal_auto sets in tenants/*.json; (2) claimant-readable vehicles for the policy on the claimant's own intake session (unitId,vin,year,make,model only), e.g. GET /intake/sessions/{id}/policy-vehicles. Claimant picker is hidden with real tokens until (2) lands.

claim.acknowledged event (data: claimId, channel, taskId, acknowledgedAt) is now published by claims on claim.reported when the tenant configures notifications.claimant.channels; needs events/claim.acknowledged.schema.json (x-publisher claims). Also added GET /intake/sessions/{id}/policy-vehicles and Party.atFault (1.3.0).
